dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The dorsal surface features approximately 4-5 prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. The perimeters consist of high-contrast white edges with jagged, non-uniform thicknesses (3-10 pixels) that exhibit a sharp gradient transition into dark, low-intensity circular interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of localized, high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge and the transition to the lateral flank. These clusters lack internal gradients and form an interconnected, web-like network of solid white against the dark base coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper-central dorsal region form an elongated scalene triangle. The distance between the two most prominent white blobs on the upper-left lateral side is approximately twice the diameter of the central-most annulus.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible upper-right appendage displays five distinct, parallel high-intensity vertical linear markers corresponding to the reflective surfaces of the claws.
